items.title: Tiny Gold Nanogaps Could Crack the Chirality Puzzle
items.summary: Looking for biosignatures across the solar system requires looking for asymmetry. Amino acids, the building blocks of proteins, are famously either “left-handed” (L) or “right-handed” (D). We know abiotic processes (i.e. those that create amino acids but don’t involve life) create a 50/50 mixture of the two types, which is called a racemic mixture. But life as we know it almost exclusively relies on left-handed amino acids to fold proteins and right-handed ones to construct nucleic acids. So if we find an imbalance in the types of amino acids we analyze from somewhere in the solar system, it's a good indication that life is behind that imbalance. Stardew Valley creator Eric Barone has been working on his new game The Haunted Chocolatier for over four years now, and during a recent chat with GQ , he's provided a quick reminder about what fans can expect from the gameplay. While the title is still what he calls a "town game" - similar to his existing farming and social sim, he sums up this new experience as "more of an action RPG". The main focus here will be all about "adventuring, finding equipment and getting more powerful", and you can also expect monsters and boss fights. Read the full article on nintendolife.com
